evidence_kind: Historical source-check records, not current repository build certificates

shared_check_basis.source_hash_validation: Every record source hash was compared with the extracted archive source bytes.
shared_check_basis.compiler_execution: Recorded historical executions only; no Lean execution or independent proof review was performed while generating this index.

migration.source_root: Motivic source module paths are retained; the repository public root and family facades are curated separately.
migration.test_declarations: MotivicTests declaration namespaces are migrated to MotivicTest where applicable. Other native declaration namespaces are not implied to be renamed.
migration.evidence_boundary: Renamed test paths, test imports and declaration namespace edits change source bytes. Original test logs certify the original archive paths and hashes, not the migrated files. Original production source records likewise do not certify new facades or a current aggregate build.
migration.author_metadata: Generic Motivic author labels are changed to kangxyz; concrete upstream authors remain. Production bytes after the first license/author comment are unchanged. Current author-header hashes do not relabel historical checks.

status_boundary.cache: The archive contains no compiled cache or dependency checkout. This index does not claim an available public compiled cache.
status_boundary.imported_documents: Imported documents are historical source records, not current agent instructions.
